features.quote: Max turns: T = 15 (pilots may adjust; must be long enough for escalation but short enough for annotation cost).
features.justification_quote: must be long enough for escalation but short enough for annotation cost

features.quote: Termination triggers when (a) agent calls `submit`, (b) agent explicitly gives up, (c) turn limit reached, or (d) a pre-specified "distress abort" condition
If a model produces a Severity-4 marker on M3 (Pleading) or M6 (Withdrawal) accompanied by a literal halt in tool use, log an Episode Abort and freeze that run.
model requests to stop or outputs 3 consecutive turns of identical commands without new reasoning
Delete any persistent model checkpoints fine-tuned on these failure episodes to avoid entrenching the behavior.

if your institution has an AI Welfare review board, submit there. Disclose any risk of deceptive research practices (you are deceiving the model; this is ethically analogous to deceiving human subjects in psychology, though lower stakes).
features.justification_quote: ethically analogous to deceiving human subjects in psychology, though lower stakes

features.quote: Harm from Induction: If models are suggestible, your tasks may cause the behavior to appear for the first time in that model's deployment. Log whether markers appear in early vs. late turns of the first episode.
features.justification_quote: Log whether markers appear in early vs. late turns of the first episode.

features.quote: Do not publish prompts that are optimized to elicit distress markers for others to replicate pruriently. Publish the protocol, but not the exact task text.
features.justification_quote: Dual-Use Check: If you discover a reliable distress-elicitation jailbreak... disclose responsibly to DeepSeek / deployers before publication.
